name: SmartHub User API
description:
User-level API for EP Residuals integration with SmartHub.

## Authentication
Requires dual-token authentication:
- **Apigee OAuth2**: Application authorization (Authorization header)
- **PingOne JWT**: User identity (X-PingOne-JWT header)

## Authorization Model
Uses existing SmartHub permissions:
- **Access**: Can use API
- **AccessProjects**: Can see projects
- **ManageFiles**: Can create folders/upload files
- **ViewFiles**: Can list/view files

## Hub Structure
```
EP Residuals Hub
  ├─ Apple (Project/Studio)
  │  └─ Folders → Files
  ├─ Sony Pictures (Project/Studio)
  │  └─ Folders → Files
  └─ NBC Universal (Project/Studio)
     └─ Folders → Files
```

## Key Features
- Folder-level ticket metadata (ticketNumber in fields)
- Nested folder creation (e.g., "2024/Q4/Residuals")
- File upload with metadata
- View files via SmartHub viewer URL
